exports.behavior: Returns the top container phase or the root phase without mutation.

exports.signature: pub fn check_payload_growth(current: usize, additional: usize, limits: Limits) -> Result<u32>
exports.behavior: Checks usize addition, u32 representability, and the inclusive payload ceiling. PayloadTooLarge uses source Syntax and the saturated current length as its offset.

exports.signature: pub(crate) fn apply(state: &mut SyntaxState, token: Token, transition: Transition) -> Result<()>
exports.behavior: Applies container pushes and matching pops, saved parent phases, inclusive depth and count limits, and object-local decoded-byte duplicate detection. Validates internal transition consistency, reserves fallibly before structural changes, and preserves the first failure.

test_vectors.expected: Successful totals fit both ceilings; rejected totals produce PayloadTooLarge without allocation.

vectors: root phase before and after an empty array
all scalar roots at depth zero
both container kinds rejected at depth zero
one push past each depth limit
test_vectors.expected: Root consumes no depth, child starts preserve advanced parent phases, matching closes restore parents, and depth errors leave structural state unchanged.

vectors: zero limits reject the first key or item
all seven value-start kinds in arrays
u32::MAX - 1 through u32::MAX and one additional count
test_vectors.expected: Array values count at their start, object fields count at their keys, and counters never wrap. Limit violations produce ConstraintViolation.

vectors: raw a and escaped \u0061 in either order
test_vectors.expected: Duplicate detection uses exact decoded UTF-8 bytes, performs no normalization or case folding, stores no key bytes when disabled, and leaves schema unknown-key policy to downstream validation.

vectors: same key in parent and child
input and arena growth after accepting a key
test_vectors.expected: Owned keys remain stable across backing storage growth and are scoped to their own object frames.

vectors: out-of-range raw and arena key references
root not advanced before an existing child
test_vectors.expected: InternalError is sticky and preserves storage contents, stack entries, phases, counters, offsets, pending token, flags, and limits.

vectors: preexisting UTF-8 error with schema and field identifiers
successful frame changes with retained input, arena, pending token, and EOF flag
test_vectors.expected: The original error is returned unchanged; framing leaves feed-owned state untouched.
Deterministic capacity overflow produces BudgetExhausted at the supplied offset without altering contents. Successful reservations provide the requested capacity.
